t: Dulce de Leche Bakery Opens Tomorrow in the Heights | Jersey Digs
s: September 8, 2016 - According to a press release from the Central Avenue SID, Dulce de Leche Bakery will officially open their doors tomorrow at 7am. The Argentine-inspired bakery will serve breakfast and lunch in addition to having a full fresh juice and smoothie bar. Foodies will be happy to know that they can find croissants, cakes, breads, and other baked goods fresh out of the oven during the late evening hours.
